items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Frankie Trumbauer came on the scene... I'd get all the recordings... he was simply terrific with Bix.

ctx.x: Records were beginning to come over from the States; is that right?

Yes, yes. Recordings started coming over, and the orchestras started being pretty popular. And you had -- Red Nichols was already on the scene. The Wolverines were on the scene. Frankie Trumbauer came on the scene. And about the same time with Fletcher Henderson and the Duke was just beginning.
